1059.description: Pull your heel toward your glute while standing to stretch the front of the thigh. It is a classic quad stretch.
instructions: Stand tall and hold something for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle.
Pull your heel toward your glute, knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

1123.description: You curl yourself up with one arm holding a single strap, a tough unilateral biceps move.
instructions: Hold one handle palm up and lean back at an angle.
Keep your feet planted and body straight.
Bend the elbow and pull your body toward your hand.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

1187.description: A sit-up holding a kettlebell for extra resistance on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a kettlebell at your chest.
Brace your core.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep the kettlebell close to you.
Lower slowly back down.

1315.description: A gentle resting position that lets the back relax and lengthen after training.
instructions: Get into a comfortable resting position, such as kneeling with your torso folded forward.
Rest your arms in a relaxed position.
Let your back round and release.
Breathe slowly into your lower back.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.

1379.description: Seated calf raise with a dumbbell resting on your knees. The bent knee focuses on the soleus beneath the calf.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface such as a step or block, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Hold onto the dumbbell for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上，并将哑铃放在大腿上。
将脚掌放在升高的表面（例如台阶或木块）上，脚跟悬在边缘外。
握住哑铃以保持稳定。
尽可能高地抬高脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1443.description: Holding dumbbells out to the sides in a lying Maltese position. It is an advanced hold for the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Lie face up with a dumbbell in each hand, palms down.
Lift your arms out to the sides at about hip level.
Keep your arms straight and your body tight.
Hold the position without letting the weights drop.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower carefully.

1507.description: A standing hip flexion with a band around the foot or leg. It trains the hip flexors and quads.
instructions: Attach a band to a low anchor and loop it around one ankle.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift the knee forward and up toward hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

1571.description: A machine leg extension done one leg at a time. It isolates the quads and helps even out strength between sides.
instructions: Sit on the machine and adjust the pad so it rests on your lower shin.
Set one foot under the pad and keep the other foot on the floor or footrest.
Extend your working leg until it is almost straight.
Squeeze your quad at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

1635.description: A one-arm reverse grip preacher curl on a cable. It works the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the pulley is at the lowest position.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable handle with an underhand grip and position your upper arm against the preacher bench pad.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Slowly curl your forearm towards your bicep, keeping your upper arm stationary against the pad.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your bicep.
Slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
instructionsZh: 调整拉索机，使滑轮处于最低位置。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用反手抓住电缆手柄，并将上臂靠在牧师凳垫上。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与其中。
慢慢地将前臂向二头肌方向卷曲，保持上臂固定在垫子上。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
慢慢地将电缆手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
交换手臂并重复练习。

1699.description: A powerful rotational throw that trains the core, hips and shoulders to work together.
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall holding a medicine ball at your hip.
Rotate away from the wall and load your back hip.
Explosively rotate and throw the ball into the wall.
Catch it on the rebound and repeat.
Switch sides after the planned reps.

1763.description: A pull-up with hands about shoulder-width apart. Builds the lats, upper back and biceps.
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with a shoulder-width grip, palms facing away from you.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 握距与肩同宽，抓住引体向上杆，手掌背向自己。
双臂完全伸展，自由悬挂。
启动背部肌肉，将身体向上拉向杠铃，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1827.description: Bending your fingers down stretches the muscles on the back of your forearm. Handy to loosen up after lots of gripping.
instructions: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing down and your wrist relaxed.
Use your other hand to gently press your fingers and hand down toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1891.description: Kneeling on the toes to stretch the feet and front of the ankles.
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your toes tucked under.
Sit back onto your heels slowly.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release and shake out your feet.

1955.description: Kneeling with one leg folded and leaning back to stretch the quadriceps.
instructions: Kneel on both knees, then lift one foot out in front so that the other leg is folded.
Place your hands behind you on the floor.
Lean back slowly until you feel a stretch in the front of the folded thigh.
Keep your hips lifted and avoid sagging into the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2147.description: A machine hip thrust with a band around the thighs, adding hip abductor work to the glute drive.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and a band around your thighs above the knees.
Place your feet flat and push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, keeping the knees pressed out.

2275.description: A rising punch with the left hand, thrown upward from the hips and legs.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your left side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your left fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your right hand guarding your chin.
Return to stance and repeat.

2339.description: A side-by-side form check for choosing the right grip width on the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Lie on the bench and grip the bar at a moderate width.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your forearms are vertical at the bottom, with hands just wider than the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2403.description: An alternating dumbbell curl with an arm blaster. Keeps your upper arms fixed so the biceps do the work.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Place the arm blaster on your upper arms, ensuring a secure fit.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with the opposite arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将手臂冲击波放在上臂上，确保牢固贴合。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将一只哑铃向上弯向肩膀，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

2659.description: A plate-loaded machine press on an incline that targets the upper chest and the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your upper chest.
Sit back and grip the handles with feet flat on the floor.
Press forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Squeeze the chest, then return slowly.
Keep your back against the pad and your shoulders down.

2723.description: Pushing a loaded wheelbarrow over a distance, building leg drive and grip.
instructions: Grip the wheelbarrow handles and lift them with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Push forward with strong steps.
Keep your arms straight and your body in line.
Set it down under control at the end.

2787.description: Bending the trunk sideways, working the obliques and mobilising the spine.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms at your sides.
Slide one hand down the outside of your leg as you bend sideways.
Keep your hips level, return to upright, then bend to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2851.description: A face-down Pilates move that opens the chest and strengthens the back.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your back.
Kick both heels toward your glutes.
Lift your chest and extend your arms back.
Lower down.
Repeat smoothly.

2915.description: Carrying a barbell in the crooks of your elbows. It loads the legs, upper back and trunk in a tough front-loaded position.
instructions: Set the bar in your elbow crooks, hugging it tight to your chest.
Stand tall with your chest up and your abs braced.
Walk with controlled steps while keeping the bar close.
Cover the set distance without rounding forward.
Lower the bar to the rack or floor carefully.

3171.description: A right-handed hook punch thrown in a boxing stance. It trains rotation and power from the hips.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your hands up.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Pivot on your back foot and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing your fist in an arc to your target.
Snap back to guard position.
Keep your chin tucked and your left hand up.

3235.description: A cable-resisted leg curl from a face-down position. It isolates the hamstrings with smooth, constant tension.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle attachment is at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs straight and the ankle attachment secured to your ankles.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整缆绳机，使脚踝附件处于最低设置。
面朝下躺在长凳上，双腿伸直，将脚踝固定装置固定在脚踝上。
握住长凳的把手以保持稳定。
保持上半身静止，呼气，弯曲膝盖，将双腿向臀肌方向卷起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的腿筋。
吸气并慢慢降低双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3299.description: A gymnastics hold where the body is parallel to the floor and balanced on the hands. It builds extreme strength in the shoulders, chest and core.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your fingers pointing forward.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, lifting your feet off the ground.
Continue shifting your weight forward until your body is parallel to the ground, balancing on your hands.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your feet back to the ground and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并缓慢地将你的重心向前移动，将你的脚抬离地面。
继续向前移动体重，直到身体与地面平行，并用双手保持平衡。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，保持身体线条笔直。
慢慢地将双脚放回地面，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3363.description: A standing close grip cable press that focuses on the triceps.
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Stand in a split stance, core tight.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.
Return slowly to the start.

3491.description: A push-up with the feet up the wall and hands on the floor. The raised feet put more load on the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place your hands on the floor and walk your feet up a wall behind you.
Set your hands under your shoulders in a straight body line.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows tucked.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Walk your feet down to finish.

3555.description: An explosive push away from a wall or support to train the upper back.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and lean in with arms extended.
Push away from the wall forcefully.
Retract your shoulder blades as you reach back.
Return to the wall with control.
Keep your core tight.
Reset between reps.

3683.description: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and step behind and across into a curtsey lunge.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one leg behind and across the other.
Lower until both knees bend.
Press through the front leg to return.
Alternate legs for the set.

3747.description: A single-leg squat where you hold a bed sheet anchored to something sturdy for assistance.
instructions: Hold the ends of a bed sheet anchored to a door or post.
Stand on one leg with the other leg extended forward.
Sit down on your standing leg, using the sheet as support.
Lower as far as you can control.
Push up to stand and switch legs after your reps.

3875.description: A hyperextension on an angled bench with a band adding load for the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree hyperextension bench with your hips just over the pad.
Loop a band across your upper back and under your feet or the base.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them lightly.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch at the top.

3939.description: Press a band overhead from behind your head to straighten the elbows. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Anchor the band low or stand on it and hold the other end behind your head.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close to your ears.
Straighten your arms overhead.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your upper arms still and your ribs down.

4003.description: A V up finishing with a clap above the legs. It trains the core and coordination.
instructions: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs into a V.
Clap above your shins.
Lower with control.
Repeat smoothly.

4067.description: Seated Arnold press alternating arms. The twist works the front and side delts.
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your palm forward.
Lower it while rotating back.
Alternate arms.
Keep your back against the pad and avoid arching.

4131.description: Alternating rope waves mixed with standing up from kneeling for a full body conditioning move.
instructions: Kneel holding the rope ends.
Make alternating waves with your arms.
Rise to a standing position while continuing.
Wave for a few more seconds.
Return to kneeling and repeat.

4195.description: A face pull in a half kneeling stance with a band.
instructions: Anchor the band at face height.
Kneel on one knee.
Pull the handles toward your face.
Flare your elbows.
Return slowly.
Keep your chest up.

4259.description: Steady walking motion on an elliptical trainer. It is a low-impact way to raise your heart rate and build endurance.
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving in a smooth, walking-style stride.
Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and core braced.
Choose a moderate resistance and keep a steady pace.
Continue for 10 to 30 minutes, depending on your fitness, then cool down slowly.

4387.description: A deep squat with palms together that opens the hips and inner thighs and builds ankle and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Press your palms together at your chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Hold for 30-60 seconds while breathing slowly.

4451.description: A bodyweight row hanging under suspension straps with a wide grip. It builds the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Hold the handles with a wide, overhand grip and lie back with your body straight.
Keep your heels on the floor and your core tight.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

4515.description: A back-clasped chest opener that lengthens the pecs and the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands together behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Open your chest and pull your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release and repeat.

4579.description: A basic step-up onto a box that builds leg and hip strength and single-leg control.
instructions: Stand facing a step box with feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through your heel to step up and stand tall.
Bring the other foot up to meet it.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch the lead leg.

4771.description: A jumping lunge where you switch your legs in the air with hands on hips. It builds explosive leg power.
instructions: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Step into a lunge position.
Jump and switch legs in the air.
Land softly in a lunge on the other leg.
Keep your chest up and repeat.

4835.description: A dumbbell bench press where your grip rotates during the press. It adds a smooth, shoulder-friendly path for the chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at chest level with palms facing each other.
Press the weights up while turning your palms to face forward.
Reach full arm extension over your chest.
Lower the weights while rotating back to a neutral grip.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades tight.

4899.description: A plate loaded machine row with a wide grip while bent over. It builds the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Load the machine and set your chest against the support.
Grab the wide handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your lower chest, elbows flaring out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad throughout.

4963.description: A squat to a box holding a kettlebell at your chest. It trains the hips and legs.
instructions: Stand in front of a box holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Push your hips back and sit onto the box.
Pause briefly.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep your chest up.
Keep your elbows close.

5027.description: Wall slide with a foam roller under your forearms. It teaches smooth shoulder blade movement and serratus control.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with a foam roller under your forearms against the wall.
Press your forearms firmly into the roller.
Roll the roller up the wall as you reach overhead.
Keep your core braced and neck relaxed.
Roll back down under control.

5091.description: Bench press with an underhand grip. It shifts more load to the upper chest and also works the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the bar with palms facing you, about shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower it to your lower chest with elbows tucked.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet down and shoulder blades pinched.

5155.description: Step sideways onto a box and drive the other knee up. It adds balance and hip flexion to the lateral step up.
instructions: Stand sideways next to a box with one foot on top.
Press through that foot to step up.
Drive your other knee up toward your chest.
Lower back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

5667.description: A seated overhead press done on the floor with legs straight out. With no back support, it trains the shoulders and demands a strong core.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and sit tall without leaning back.
Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders with control.

5859.description: Lift a kettlebell straight in front of you to shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands by the sides of the handle.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the kettlebell to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

6051.description: A squat from a kneeling position holding a bottle. It trains the glutes and hips without loading your feet.
instructions: Kneel on a mat with hips over knees, holding a bottle at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Pause lightly, keeping your back straight.
Drive your hips forward to return to upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

6435.description: A bridge with heels pushed into the floor and toes lifted. It biases the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, toes lifted.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

6755.description: A light rotation drill with a cable that turns the arm outward. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructions: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

7203.description: A squat that steps sideways against a band, firing up the glutes and hips.
instructions: Place the band around your thighs and stand with feet hip-width.
Sit into a squat and stay low.
Step one foot out to the side against the band.
Bring the other foot in to follow.
Take several steps, then return the other way.
Keep your knees pushed out.

7587.description: A one-arm cable row from a high pulley while your chest rests on a pad. The support lets you focus on the upper back without cheating.
instructions: Set a handle on a high pulley and lean your chest against the support.
Grab the handle with one hand and let your arm extend.
Pull your elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end of the pull.
Return slowly to full extension, finish your reps, then switch arms.

8611.description: A seated ankle drill that works the muscles on the outside of the lower leg.
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the inside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

9187.description: Raising a stick in front of you with straight arms warms up the shoulders. It is a light, controlled drill.
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick in front of you to shoulder height or above.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for smooth reps.

9315.description: A split squat with the rear foot on a bench builds leg strength and balance, one leg at a time.
instructions: Stand a stride length in front of a bench and rest your back foot on it.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Drive through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

9699.description: A one-arm row with your chest braced on an incline bench. It lets you focus on each side of the back.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

10595.description: A lying throw and catch that sends a medicine ball overhead and back. It trains explosive lat and core strength.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Pull the ball forward over your chest to throw it up toward a partner or wall.
Catch the ball with soft elbows as it returns.
Let it travel back overhead in a controlled arc.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Repeat at a steady rhythm.

10851.description: A reformer squat variation that builds the legs. It focuses on controlled bending and straightening.
instructions: Set your feet on the carriage and platform.
Stand tall and brace your core.
Bend your knees into a squat.
Keep your chest lifted and knees over toes.
Press back up to standing.
Move with the carriage smoothly.

10915.description: A one-legged hinge held at the bottom. It builds balance and the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward from the hips as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Hold for several seconds, hips level.
Return upright and switch legs.

0035.description: A decline skull crusher that lowers the bar toward the forehead and presses it back up. Targets the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet and hold a barbell with a close grip.
Lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms to press the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在下斜长凳上，头低于脚，紧紧握住杠铃。
弯曲肘部，将杠铃向前额降低，保持上臂静止。
暂停片刻，然后伸展双臂将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0099.description: A split squat with the rear foot raised and a bar on your back. Strong work for the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Take a large step forward with one leg, keeping your torso upright.
Lower your body by bending your front knee and hip, while keeping your back leg straight.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
单腿向前迈出一大步，保持躯干直立。
弯曲前膝盖和臀部，降低身体，同时保持后腿伸直。
继续降低，直到大腿前侧与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后推动前脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

0163.description: A seated row facing a cable stack. It builds the mid back and lats with smooth constant tension.
instructions: Sit at a cable row station with your feet on the platform and your knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle with both hands and sit tall.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and avoid rocking back.

0227.description: A standing cable fly where you bring the handles together in front of the chest. It trains the pecs with constant tension.
instructions: Attach the handles to the cables at chest height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing away from the cable machine.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, palms facing forward.
Step forward slightly to create tension in the cables.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the exercise.
With a slight bend in your elbows, slowly bring your arms forward and together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest muscles at the peak of the movement.
Slowly reverse the movement, returning your arms to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将手柄连接到胸部高度的电缆上。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，背对缆绳机。
正手握住手柄，手掌朝前。
稍微向前一步以在缆绳中产生张力。
在整个练习过程中保持核心参与并保持背部挺直。
肘部稍微弯曲，慢慢地将双臂向前并拢在胸前。
在运动的最高点挤压胸部肌肉。
慢慢扭转动作，将手臂恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0291.description: A dumbbell squat to a bench. Touching the bench gives a consistent depth and works the glutes and thighs.
instructions: Place a dumbbell on the ground in front of a bench.
Stand facing away from the bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the knees and hips to lower yourself down towards the bench, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Once your glutes touch the bench, push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将哑铃放在长凳前的地面上。
背对长凳站立，双脚与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，将自己降低到长凳上，保持胸部挺直，背部挺直。
一旦你的臀部接触到长凳，就用脚后跟站起来，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0355.description: You raise one dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height, one arm at a time. It builds the side of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing your body.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Raise the dumbbell to the side, keeping your arm straight and your palm facing down.
Continue lifting until your arm is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一手握住哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与其中。
将哑铃举至一侧，保持手臂伸直，手掌朝下。
继续抬起，直到手臂与地面平行。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0419.description: You lift dumbbells in front of you and up above head height. It works the front shoulders and upper chest.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and lift the dumbbells in front of you, raising them above your head.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
保持双臂伸直，将哑铃举至身前，举过头顶。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0547.description: You press one kettlebell up while the other lowers, like a seesaw. Works the shoulders and triceps with a steady rhythm.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one kettlebell overhead while keeping the other kettlebell at shoulder height.
Lower the pressed kettlebell back to shoulder height while simultaneously pressing the other kettlebell overhead.
Continue alternating the pressing motion, creating a seesaw-like movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个壶铃，与肩同高。
将一个壶铃压过头顶，同时将另一个壶铃保持在肩膀高度。
将按下的壶铃降低至肩膀高度，同时将另一个壶铃压过头顶。
继续交替按压动作，形成跷跷板状的运动。
重复所需的重复次数。

0611.description: A lunge flowing into a push-up. It combines leg and upper body work for a full-body challenge.
instructions: Stand tall with feet together.
Step back into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Place your hands on the floor and step into a plank.
Lower into a push-up and press back up.
Step back into the lunge and stand up.
Alternate the lunging leg each rep.

0675.description: Lying face down on a stability ball, you raise your legs behind you. Works the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down on a stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your legs extended straight behind you.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for stability.
Engaging your glutes and hamstrings, lift your legs up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面朝下躺在稳定球上，臀部放在球上，双腿伸直在身后。
将双手放在身前的地面上以保持稳定。
调动臀肌和腿筋，将双腿尽可能高地抬向天花板。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0739.description: On a 45 degree sled, you press the platform away with your feet. Works the quads and glutes.
instructions: Adjust the seat and footplate of the sled machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your legs, keeping your heels on the footplate.
Continue pushing until your legs are almost fully extended, but without locking your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the footplate back towards your body by bending your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机的座椅和脚踏板调整到舒适的位置。
坐在雪橇机上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚与肩同宽放在踏板上。
握住座椅两侧的把手以保持稳定性。
伸展双腿，将脚踏板推离身体，脚后跟保持在脚踏板上。
继续推动，直到双腿几乎完全伸展，但不要锁住膝盖。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后弯曲膝盖，慢慢地将踏板放回到身体的方向。
重复所需的重复次数。

0803.description: A push-up in which you lift the opposite arm and leg at the top, like Superman. It trains the chest, back and core stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
As you lower your body, simultaneously lift your right arm and left leg off the ground, extending them straight out.
Pause for a moment at the top, then lower your arm and leg back down while pushing yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time lifting your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
收紧核心，将身体降低到地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
当你降低身体时，同时将右臂和左腿抬离地面，笔直向外伸展。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后放下手臂和腿，同时将自己推回起始位置。
重复该动作，这次抬起左臂和右腿。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0867.description: A plank held face up, supported on your hands and heels. It strengthens the back of the body and opens up the chest.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight and hands behind your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press into your hands and heels to lift your hips.
Straighten your body from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower your hips with control.

0931.description: A diagonal twist with a band moving from low to high. It trains the obliques.
instructions: Anchor the band low and hold it with both hands beside the anchor.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso, pulling the band diagonally up.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

0995.description: A seated hip rotation with a band for resistance, working the glutes and deep hip rotators.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with a band looped around your knees or thighs.
Keep your feet planted and your back tall.
Push your knees apart against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring your knees back together slowly.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning.
